acceptance: Exact target integers equal independent path-enumeration / reachability reference; invalid requests must refuse; fresh artifact receipt bound to exact mission, capability, checker and criteria. Historical evidence grants no current proof or authority.

alternativeThreshold.economicImplication: none without external usefulness and complete attributable costs
alternativeThreshold.metric: at least 50 percent fewer repeated module qualification cases than full replay
alternativeThreshold.requires: identical acceptance/rejection decisions and fresh input/output checking on every mission, including explicit corruption/stale-context controls

blindness: Held-out task bytes and checker reside outside enterprise source directory. Proposer instructed not to inspect them. Same-controller process boundary, not hostile OS isolation or institutional blindness.
expert: supplied deterministic direct specialist algorithm, no recruited human expert

load.timing: wall and CPU; report source qualification separately from warm task throughput

noPosthocTuning: scored failures retained; fixes require a new version and separate rerun; original runs retained
prescoreCorrection: Original fully connected Boolean task bank was too weak (all targets reached); v1 preserved. Before candidate/results, v2 adds disconnected targets, zero seeds and mixed reachability. No scored output informed this correction.
uncertainty: finite population with repeated seeds; descriptive intervals do not imply generalization
